document.abstract: (1.1) This standard specifies the position, dimensions, and reproducing speed of the magnetic audio record on 8-mm type S motion-picture film having a nominal 0.027-in (0.69-mm) width magnetic stripe. (1.2) This standard also specifies the longitudinal picture-audio displacement on the film.
